stage: Stage 1 · the skeleton, with every eval
title: The runtime
summary: Every operation now runs through one wrapper. It checks the payload, runs the handler as counted work so the world can tell when it's quiet, records a span named after the operation with the payload on it, gives each step its own span, and checks the answer. It runs inside real workerd, writing to a real local D1. Along the way, amounts now travel as text, since a JSON number can't hold 128 bits.
proves: A unit test with the in-memory exporter shows a span named allowance.grant with its payload's attributes.

captions.01-runtime-tests: The runtime's tests: counted work, timers on a test clock, and the wrapper's span, refusals and answer check.
captions.02-spans-of-one-grant: One grant, and the spans it recorded: allowance.grant with its payload, and the insert step inside it.
captions.03-workerd-and-real-d1: Inside real workerd: a real D1 row through SqlClient, and the wrapper's step writing the largest 128-bit amount.
captions.04-all-checks-green: Lint, typecheck and test across all 14 projects, cache off.
